## Setup

```{r Load required packages and data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(tableone)
library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(knitr)
library(grid)


## Read in data
df <- read.delim(file="../data/cleaned_data.csv", sep=",", header=TRUE)

```


```{r Define some variables etc}


## Define relevant objects
dict_drugs <- setNames(c("Clopidogrel", "Prasugrel", "Ticagrelor"),
                       nm=c("B01AC04", "B01AC22", "B01AC24"))

## Create variable time_to_event_years (existing column time_to_event is saved as time to event in days)
df$time_to_event_years <- df$time_to_event/365.25


## Create Column of inhibitors 
df$drugname <- dict_drugs[df$inhibitor] 
df$drugname <- dict_drugs[df$inhibitor] %>% factor(., levels=c("Clopidogrel", "Prasugrel", "Ticagrelor"))


## Change class of some variables to the type that will be used in modeling
df <- df %>% mutate(year_of_start = factor(as.character(year_of_start), levels=c("2020", "2021", "2022")))
  

```

<br><br><br>

## Descriptive Analysis: Tables

Simple table giving an overview of distribution of the three treatment groups

```{r Create descriptive table of distribution of the three treatment groups}

## Create simple table
tab_simple <- tabyl(df$drugname) %>%
  rename(Drug = `df$drugname`) %>%
  adorn_totals() %>%
  mutate(percent = round(percent * 100, 1))
print(tab_simple)


```

Table1 giving an overview of covariate distributions for adjustment:

```{r Table1}


## Create Table 1 dataframe with nicer names
df_t1 <- df
df_t1 <- dplyr::rename(
  df_t1,
  "Age (years)" = age_in_years,
  "Length of hospital stay (days)" = days_in_hosp__hosp,
  "Hospital days (eligibility period)" = days_in_hosp__eligibility,
  "Number of comorbidities (hospital stay)" = number_com_ICD__hosp,
  "Number of comorbidities (eligibility period)" = number_com_ICD__eligibility,
  "Total drug redemptions" = total_redemptions__eligibility,
  "Sex" = sex,
  "Year of treatment start" = year_of_start
)


## Define continuous and categorial adjustment variables as well as the grouping variable. Then construct table of adjustment variables.
cont_vars_t1 <- c(
  "Age (years)",
  "Length of hospital stay (days)",
  "Hospital days (eligibility period)",
  "Number of comorbidities (hospital stay)",
  "Number of comorbidities (eligibility period)",
  "Total drug redemptions"
)
cat_vars_t1 <- c(
  "Sex", "Year of treatment start",
  "A10A", "A10B", "B01", "R01", "R03",
  "C01", "C02", "C03", "C07", "C08", "C09", "C10"
)
group_var <- "drugname"       


## Define which variables should be summarized by median and IQR
skewed_vars_t1 <- cont_vars_t1


## Add attributes so that labels are nicer (Comment-AI: Asked how to add nicer labels)
tab_table1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = c(cont_vars_t1, cat_vars_t1),
  strata = group_var,
  data = df_t1,
  factorVars = cat_vars_t1,
  addOverall = TRUE,
  test = FALSE
)


## Print table, and prepare input for kable
tab_table1_print <- print(
  tab_table1,
  showAllLevels = TRUE,
  nonnormal = skewed_vars_t1,
  quote = FALSE,
  noSpaces =FALSE
)


## Print via kable (nicer to look at)
kable(tab_table1_print)

```

## Descriptive Analysis: Kaplan Meier and reverse Kaplan-Meier

```{r Kaplan Meier curves}


## Fit overall KM + 95%CI for time until ACS recurrence or death
Fig1 <- survfit2(Surv(time_to_event_years, last_status) ~ 1, df,  conf.int = 0.95) %>% 
    ggsurvfit() + 
    add_confidence_interval() +
    add_risktable() + 
    scale_ggsurvfit() + 
    ylab("Probability of no event") + 
    xlab("Years") + ggtitle("Figure1: Kaplan-Meier estimate (overall) of ACS recurrence or death") +
    ylim(0.75,1)
ggsave(
  filename = "../output/figures/Fig1__DescriptiveAnalysis__KM_overall.pdf",
  plot = grid::grid.draw(Fig1),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)


## Fit overall reverse KM + 95 CI for time until censoring
df$reverse_last_status <- ifelse(test = df$last_status==1, yes=0, no=1)
Fig2 <- survfit2(Surv(time_to_event_years, reverse_last_status) ~ 1, df, conf.int = 0.95) %>% 
    ggsurvfit() + 
    add_confidence_interval() +
    add_risktable() + 
    scale_ggsurvfit() + 
    ylab(ylab("Probability of follow-up >= t")) + 
    xlab("Years") + ggtitle("Figure2: reverse Kaplan-Meier estimate (overall) of follow-up time")
ggsave(
  filename = "../output/figures/Fig2__DescriptiveAnalysis__reverseKM_overall.pdf",
  plot = grid::grid.draw(Fig2),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)


## Fit stratisfied reverse KM + 95 CI for time until censoring
df$reverse_last_status <- ifelse(test = df$last_status==1, yes=0, no=1)
Fig3 <- survfit2(Surv(time_to_event_years, reverse_last_status) ~ drugname, df, conf.int = 0.95) %>% 
    ggsurvfit() + 
    add_confidence_interval() +
    add_risktable() + 
    scale_ggsurvfit() + 
    ylab(ylab("Probability of follow-up >= t")) + 
    xlab("Years") + ggtitle("Figure3: stratisfied reverse Kaplan-Meier estimates of follow-up time")
ggsave(
  filename = "../output/figures/Fig3__DescriptiveAnalysis__reverseKM_stratified.pdf",
  plot = grid::grid.draw(Fig3),
  width = 8,
  height = 8
)


## report median follow-up time (overall)
rev_km_overall <- survfit2( Surv(time_to_event_years, reverse_last_status) ~ 1, df)
table_reverse_km_overall <- summary(rev_km_overall)$table
paste0("median follow-up time in years (overall): ", round(table_reverse_km_overall["median"], digits=2))


## report median follow-up time (stratisfied)
rev_km_stratisfied <- survfit2(Surv(time_to_event_years, reverse_last_status) ~ drugname, df)
table_reverse_km_stratified <- summary(rev_km_stratisfied)$table
paste0("median follow-up time in years (stratisfied by inhibitor): ")
table_reverse_km_stratified[,"median"] %>% round(., digits=3)




```


The median follow-up time (overall) is
`r round(as.numeric(table_reverse_km_overall["median"]), digits=2)` years.


The median follow-up time in years, stratified by inhibitor (Clopidogrel, Prasugrel, Ticagrelor), is:
`r table_reverse_km_stratified[,"median"] %>% round(., digits=3)`, respectively.
